# Firebase browser ESM

Firebase 13.0.0 App and Auth browser modules from the official Google CDN.
`provenance.json` records upstream and vendored SHA-256 digests. License notices
are retained in each file. The only changes are a relative App import in Auth
removal of development source-map references, and whitespace normalization
outside JavaScript literals. No Node.js package or runtime
is used. Upgrade the two modules together and verify the upstream digests.

Upstream: https://firebase.google.com/docs/web/alt-setup
License: Apache-2.0, https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
